title: Lab 302 - Git and GitLab - Local Repository and Push - Advanced

lab_objective.description: By the end of this lab, you should be able to:
objectives: Create a Git repository from scratch on a Linux VM.
Create directories and files with content or code.
Understand the working directory, staging area, commits, and remote repository.
Use git status, git diff, git diff --cached, git log, and git show.
Connect a local repository to a new GitLab project.
Create and work with a basic Git branch.
scenario: You are working as a Linux Systems Administrator who needs to manage project files using Git and GitLab.
In this lab, you will create a Git repository from scratch on your assigned Linux VM rather than cloning an existing repository.
You will create project files, initialize the local repository, stage changes, create commits, and review the commit history.
You will then connect the local repository to a new blank GitLab project and push your local commits.
You will also practice reviewing unstaged and staged changes and demonstrate the differences between git fetch, git merge, and git pull.
Important: Create the GitLab project as a blank project without initializing it with a README. Use your actual GitLab username or namespace in the SSH remote URL.

Concept: git pull fetches changes from the remote repository and integrates them into the current local branch. It normally performs a fetch followed by a merge, although configuration can cause it to rebase instead. In contrast, git push sends local commits to the remote repository.

completion_message: Excellent work! You have completed Lab 302 - Git and GitLab - Local Repository and Push - Advanced. You created a Git repository from scratch, managed files and commits, connected your local repository to GitLab, pushed changes, inspected staged and unstaged differences, and practiced git pull. You now have practical experience with local version control and remote repository synchronization. Keep practicing these workflows to strengthen your Linux and DevOps skills.
